Hi Sofia — really glad the pilot was useful. Short answer: yes, we can offer a conversion but there are a couple of standard ways customers do this depending on procurement needs. We discussed with finance and product; here are the options so procurement can pick a path:

1) Pro-rated credit (default)
   - Convert unused calendar days into a one-time credit at a pro-rated rate based on the pilot purchase.
   - Credit applies to hosted consumption or as a dollar offset against a Dedicated reservation within 90 days.

2) Bridge top-up + credit (recommended for conversion path)
   - Apply a partial credit today and offer a reduced-rate top-up to extend the evaluation to full production testing.
   - This helps operational continuity and keeps the current model variant pinned during conversion.

3) Voucher-for-commit (enterprise path)
   - Convert unused days into a milestone voucher that applies against a signed reserved capacity contract; typically requires a PO and signature.

Quick notes and constraining items:
- We typically cap pro-rated credits at the original invoice amount for the pilot.
- Credits cannot be converted to cash and expire 6 months from issuance.
- For voucher/apply-to-reservation we need a PO or signed amendment.

I'm looping in Ben (cc) for a short estimate spreadsheet showing the $ value per unused day; Ben will attach an estimate so procurement has a line item to include in their approval packet. If you prefer, we can also produce a DocuSign amendment for procurement to sign.

Action items:
- Ben: please attach the estimate mapping days -> credits and an example invoice flow.
- Sofia/Procurement: tell us which option you want and whether you need a PO up front.

Best,

Hi team — looped in from finance. I ran the numbers based on the usage report and the original pilot invoice. Proposed finance guidance:

- Conversion rate: 1 unused pilot day = $1,250 credit (this is pro-rated from the pilot package cost and maintains parity with our time-box pricing bands).
- Example: 8 unused days -> $10,000 credit.
- Credit expiration: 6 months from issuance.
- Approved discount: we can also offer a one-time 10% uplift to the credit if ClariQ signs a 12-month Dedicated commitment within 30 days. This is a limited concession tied to a contract signature.

Attachments: estimate-clariq-topup.xlsx (line items, invoice example).

Procurement notes: if you need an invoice amendment or voucher language for a PO, provide the PO number and billing contact and we will generate a DocuSign amendment. Also note: credits apply to SKU-level usage and cannot be transferred outside the ClariQ account.

Naomi/Ben — happy to discuss if you want to tweak the uplift or the expiry window.

Thanks,
